text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Alrighty then. ...Can everyone hear us~? 
...Yeah, looks like we're good? Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, we're kicking off an impromptu stream! 
It's Curren Chan here♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, and I am Ma-chan. 
Together we are the "Chan-Chan Alliance," 
and...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And I'm Nice Nature... wait, you made me 
do it too. 
Umm, yeah, just your regular old 
Nature-san here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is the volume okay for everyone? Nobody's 
too quiet, right~? 
...Ah, looks like we're all set. Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I bet you're all surprised, huh? 
"What's with this out of nowhere?" "This 
lineup...?" "Are you in a kitchen?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We're coming to you live 
from the dorm kitchen. 
If I had to give you one more hint—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, someone already guessed it! Yup, 
Valentine's Day is just around the corner♪ 
So, we've invited three great cooks 
over...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And we're doing a practice chocolate cake 
making stream! 
Alright then—cooking, start♡
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh, nice, looking good! 
As expected of Curren, you're a really 
quick learner.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Once I know how it works♪ But... 
A hand mixer is—whoa, this might be pretty 
tricky~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ma-chan-san, how is the double boiler 
coming along?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmm-mmm. Melting it evenly is quite... 
Ah! 
There is still a Mr. Chocolate Chunk... 
Hmph! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Splurt! ...I've... been... hit...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, Curren got hit too~... 
...Teacher~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. There, there. You want to keep that 
spatula-looking thing pressed against the 
bottom of the bowl~

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By the way, how is Zephyr-san doing... 
—Oh! 
What a wonderful piece of work. Is that a 
bird?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, one of the residents of the academy's 
forest. 
...I thought perhaps it could breathe 
happiness into everyone...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho! In that case, we must absolutely 
have it enthroned right on top.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I sense a masterpiece in the 
making! 
You can all look forward to it~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, our cake making is done 
for today! 
How did everyone like today's stream?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It was mostly just practice, buuut...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we forgot to explain, tee-hee♡ 
Wondering why the five of us are streaming 
together~?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—To put it simply: To deliver a fun 
Valentine's Day to everyone who always 
supports us! That's why!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan-Chan Alliance, with the Rare 
Character-z, check it. Aight, yo.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yo"... what even is that? 
And calling us "rare"...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you don't really appear on streams 
very often, right? 
Look, everyone's super happy!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, from here on out, this Rare Chan-z 
crew is going to hype up Valentine's Day. 
Hype, hype.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
On the big day, we'll bake a special 
chocolate cake... 
And reveal it to everyone♡

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hate to cut in while we're having so much 
fun, but... 
Curren-san, it's about time to wrap up.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! 
Well then, that's all for today...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sad to say goodbye? Then today's 
stream was a huge success♡ 
Valentine's is still just getting started♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's all have tons of fun together, okay? 
Now let's sign off with our closing 
greeting! Ready, everyone... and one, two,

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Buh-bye~♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Great work on our very first stream, 
everyone! 
You were all utterly adorable♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. The comments section was lively as 
well. 
As planned, we must have made quite the 
impact.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the posts on social media, many 
people are looking forward to what's 
coming next. 
For now, we can call this a very solid 
start.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to everyone's coaching! 
That was a nice pick of members, Ma-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, was this project 
originally Ma-chan's idea?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
One day—Ma-chan received divine 
inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Love to the fans. Deliver the ultimate 
Valentine's—" 
It was the whisper of a god. In reality, 
it was a TV special about Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the fans... In order to 
make it a reality, Ma-chan decided to 
gather the loving and beloved Emissaries 
of Love.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The fluffy, mysterious Ma-chan, 
possessing mascot-level cuteness. 
The charismatic evangelist of cute, the 
divinely sophisticated Curren-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To that, add the refreshing, natural 
forest-girl healing aura of Zephyr-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The embodiment of approachability who 
never fails to captivate ordinary 
households, Nature-san. 
And the delightfully unexpected Ikuno-san, 
combining a cool demeanor with a 
willingness to play along.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Creating chemical reactions with everyone 
guarantees fun. The fans will be 
overjoyed, and Chan-chan's adorableness 
will spread far and wide... It's a 
win-win."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, so that's the plan? I really like 
that side of you, Chan-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"I am both honored and humbled. Though I 
feel I have left everything to you, 
Curren-san, from arranging the streaming 
equipment to running the show."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"That's where my pride as an influencer 
comes in♪ Besides, I want our fans to have 
just as much fun as you do!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"As for our upcoming schedule... Starting 
tomorrow, we'll keep posting photos on 
social media to remind everyone about the 
project and build up hype."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"And we'll do two mini-streams before the 
big day! Let's watch the real-time 
reactions and fine-tune what we do♪"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I see... So we refine the plan as we 
gauge what content generates the most 
excitement. Understood."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"As expected of Curren, she's so 
capable... I was a little worried at 
first, but it seems like even I'll be able 
to manage."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Let's do our best to make this a 
wonderful Valentine's Day that brings joy 
to all our fans!"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
